items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother was – her maiden name was Payne – Edna Gertrude Payne.

ctx.x: If you could tell us your father’s full name, your mother’s full name.
My father was Gus Haynes. My mother was – her maiden name was Payne – Edna Gertrude Payne.
